policy: random legal action selection; no language model or task-conditioned logic
stopping: original 80 consumed robot decisions or original sim/wall budget; repeated gripper no-ops are recorded but do not consume robot decisions; 200 finite proposals prevent premature scripted-list exhaustion
observation_use: first public robot TCP position initializes nominal waypoint walk; orientation deltas use current public TCP orientation; no RGB/depth/target coordinates used
position_sampling: nominal waypoint += independent uniform(-.04,.04) per axis, then clip to public workspace minus margin; absolute waypoint command (not measured-state random walk)
preserved: same perception services available but unused by blind policy
difference: official scripted runner, mutation-only allowlist; not an untrained neural network
pilot_exclusion: two unbounded delta pilots ended with workspace infra faults; one unbounded and one 80-proposal bounded adapter pilot were stopped; none counted as task failures
